SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Central Station,
REPORT
Date Dec. 21st, 1936.
Subject New office of Italian Commercial Counsellor opened.
Made by S. I. Loir Forwarded by [Signature] Officer in Charge

Sir,
I beg to report that no untoward incident occurred at
the opening ceremony by Italian Ambassador to China, His
Excellency Vincenzo Lojacono of the new office of the Commercial
Counsellor to the Royal Italian Embassy in Shanghai located
in the Yangtsze Insurance Building, No. 26 The Bund. The
reception was held between 11.30 a.m. and 12.30 p.m. 21-12-36,
Many prominent people attended including Mr. Yu Teh Chien, Mayor
of Greater Shanghai.
Extra police were on duty outside the building while
the reception was in progress.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
S. I.

D.O. "A". D.C. Div
Information
Thos Robertson
D C A

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE (DIVISIONS) 22 DEC 1936）

档案号。
中央捕房，
报告
日期：1936年12月21日。
事由：意大利商务参赞新办事处启用。
呈报人：S. I. Loir 转呈人：[签名] 主管警官

阁下：
谨此报告，意大利驻华大使文森佐·洛亚科诺（Vincenzo Lojacono）阁下于外滩26号扬子保险公司大楼举行的意大利皇家驻沪大使馆商务参赞新办事处启用典礼上，未发生任何意外事件。招待会于1936年12月21日上午11时30分至下午12时30分举行。许多知名人士出席，包括大上海市长俞鸿钧先生。
在招待会进行期间，增派警力在大楼外执勤。

此致，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
[签名]
S. I.

助理警务处长（各分区）办公室 D.C. Div
情报
Thos Robertson
D C A

Subject Arrival of the Italian Ambassador on January 7.
Made XX and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

In connection with the arrival of the new Italian
Ambassador, His Excellency Vincenzo Lojacono, on the
S.S. "Conte Rosso", which is due in Shanghai on January 7,
and will tie up at the Whangpoo Wharf, the following
men from the Special Branch will attend :-
D. S. Sansom
D. S. Lingard
D. I. Pan Lien-pih.
C.D.S. 156 Zah Pao Ying.

A Grubb.
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)

January 6, 30.

Consul General for Italy,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No.12, Pos. Pers. 5 of January 4, with
reference to the arrival in Shanghai of the new Italian
Ambassador, His Excellency Vincenzo Lojacono and, in
reply, to inform you that the necessary Police arrange-
ments will be made as requested.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Commissioner of Police.

1月6日，30年。

意大利驻沪总领事，
上海。

阁下：

荣幸地确认收到阁下1月4日第12号、Pos. Pers. 5号来函，关于新任意大利大使文森佐·洛亚科诺（Vincenzo Lojacono）阁下抵达上海一事，兹复告如下：警方将按要求作出必要安排。

荣幸地成为，
阁下，
您恭顺的仆人，

警务处处长。

Date 7 / 1 / 35

CONSOLATO GENERALE D' ITALIA
SHANGHAI

No. 12.
Pos. Pers. 5.

Shanghai, January 4th, 1935 (XIII).

To the Commissioner of Police
Shanghai Municipal Council
LOCAL

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the new Italian
Ambassador His Excellency Vincenzo Lojacono, is expected
to arrive here by the S/S "Conte Rosso" on the 7th inst.
He will land at the Whangpoo Wharf and I should be grate-
ful if you would kindly give instructions for the usual
Police arrangements in the neighbourhood of the Jetty.

Thanking you in anticipation,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

Consul General for Italy.

阁下：

荣幸地通知阁下，新任意大利大使文森佐·洛亚科诺（Vincenzo Lojacono）阁下预计将于本月7日乘坐“罗索伯爵”号轮船（S/S "Conte Rosso"）抵达此地。他将在黄浦码头登陆，如蒙阁下吩咐在码头附近采取常规的警方安保措施，不胜感激。

预先致谢，
